    "# ======================================================================\n",
    "# WORLD COMMERCIAL NETWORK (1988): INFERENCE OF GRAVITY VS GEOPOLITICS\n",
    "# ======================================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "import time\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist\n",
    "\n",
    "device = torch.device(\"cpu\")\n",
    "torch.manual_seed(0)\n",
    "np.random.seed(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 1. Load Country Coordinates & Bilateral Trade Flows (1988)\n",
    "# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "coords_file = \"data/World_commercial_network/countries_codes_and_coordinates.csv\"\n",
    "trade_file = \"data/World_commercial_network/Trade_GPH0_1988_Export_2026Jan11.csv\"\n",
    "\n",
    "# Load Coordinates\n",
    "df_coords = pd.read_csv(coords_file)\n",
    "df_coords.columns = [c.strip().replace('\"', '') for c in df_coords.columns]\n",
    "for col in df_coords.columns:\n",
    "    df_coords[col] = df_coords[col].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace('\"', '')\n",
    "\n",
    "df_coords[\"lat\"] = pd.to_numeric(df_coords[\"Latitude (average)\"], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
    "df_coords[\"lon\"] = pd.to_numeric(df_coords[\"Longitude (average)\"], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
    "df_coords = df_coords.dropna(subset=[\"Alpha-3 code\", \"lat\", \"lon\"]).copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "iso_to_lat = dict(zip(df_coords[\"Alpha-3 code\"], df_coords[\"lat\"]))\n",
    "iso_to_lon = dict(zip(df_coords[\"Alpha-3 code\"], df_coords[\"lon\"]))\n",
    "iso_to_name = dict(zip(df_coords[\"Alpha-3 code\"], df_coords[\"Country\"]))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Load Bilateral Trade Data\n",
    "df_trade = pd.read_csv(trade_file)\n",
    "df_trade.columns = [c.strip() for c in df_trade.columns]\n",
    "df_trade[\"src\"] = df_trade[\"ReporterISO3\"].astype(str).str.strip()\n",
    "df_trade[\"dst\"] = df_trade[\"PartnerISO3\"].astype(str).str.strip()\n",
    "df_trade[\"val\"] = pd.to_numeric(df_trade[\"TradeValue\"], errors=\"coerce\").fillna(0.0)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Aggregate total trade volume across all product classes\n",
    "trade_agg = df_trade.groupby([\"src\", \"dst\"])[\"val\"].sum().reset_index()\n",
    "trade_agg = trade_agg[trade_agg[\"val\"] > 0].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Find intersecting countries with valid spatial coordinates\n",
    "valid_countries = sorted(list(set(trade_agg[\"src\"]).union(set(trade_agg[\"dst\"])).intersection(set(iso_to_lat.keys()))))\n",
    "country_trade = trade_agg.groupby(\"src\")[\"val\"].sum().add(trade_agg.groupby(\"dst\")[\"val\"].sum(), fill_value=0)\n",
    "\n",
    "df_countries = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    \"iso\": valid_countries,\n",
    "    \"name\": [iso_to_name[c] for c in valid_countries],\n",
    "    \"lat\": [iso_to_lat[c] for c in valid_countries],\n",
    "    \"lon\": [iso_to_lon[c] for c in valid_countries],\n",
    "    \"total_trade\": [country_trade.get(c, 0.0) for c in valid_countries]\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "# Select Top Global Trading Nations (e.g. Top 100)\n",
    "N_NATIONS = min(100, len(df_countries[df_countries[\"total_trade\"] > 0]))\n",
    "df_top = df_countries.sort_values(\"total_trade\", ascending=False).head(N_NATIONS).copy().reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "top_iso = set(df_top[\"iso\"])\n",
    "iso_to_idx = {iso: i for i, iso in enumerate(df_top[\"iso\"])}\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Loaded {len(trade_agg)} bilateral trade flows across {len(df_coords)} geocoded countries.\")\n",
    "print(f\"Selected Top {N_NATIONS} Global Trading Nations in 1988.\")\n",
    "print(f\"Top 5 Exporters/Partners: {', '.join(df_top['name'].head(5).values)} ({', '.join(df_top['iso'].head(5).values)})\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 2. Build 3D Spherical Earth Coordinates & Weighted Trade Adjacency\n",
    "# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "R_EARTH = 6371.0 # km\n",
    "lat_rad = np.radians(df_top[\"lat\"].values)\n",
    "lon_rad = np.radians(df_top[\"lon\"].values)\n",
    "\n",
    "x_geo = R_EARTH * np.cos(lat_rad) * np.cos(lon_rad)\n",
    "y_geo = R_EARTH * np.cos(lat_rad) * np.sin(lon_rad)\n",
    "z_geo = R_EARTH * np.sin(lat_rad)\n",
    "X_3d = np.column_stack([x_geo, y_geo, z_geo])\n",
    "\n",
    "# Physical chordal distance matrix in km\n",
    "D_phys = cdist(X_3d, X_3d)\n",
    "np.fill_diagonal(D_phys, 1e9)\n",
    "iu, ju = np.triu_indices(N_NATIONS, k=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Build symmetric trade matrix\n",
    "W_dir = np.zeros((N_NATIONS, N_NATIONS))\n",
    "for _, row in trade_agg.iterrows():\n",
    "    s, d, v = str(row[\"src\"]), str(row[\"dst\"]), float(row[\"val\"])\n",
    "    if s in top_iso and d in top_iso:\n",
    "        W_dir[iso_to_idx[s], iso_to_idx[d]] += v\n",
    "\n",
    "# Symmetrize total bilateral trade volume: log-scale stabilizes multi-order skew\n",
    "W_raw = 0.5 * (W_dir + W_dir.T)\n",
    "W = np.log1p(W_raw)\n",
    "c_target = float(W.sum(axis=1).mean())\n",
    "\n",
    "r0 = float(2.0 * D_phys.min(axis=1).mean())\n",
    "log_r0 = float(np.log(r0))\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Mean node strength c = {c_target:.2f} | Geographical trade distance: [{D_phys.min():.0f} - {D_phys[iu, ju].max():.0f}] km | r0 = {r0:.0f} km\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 3. Gauge-Invariant Profile Likelihood Inference\n",
    "# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "t0 = time.time()\n",
    "SIGMA_GAUGE = 1.0\n",
    "d_s = 2\n",
    "\n",
    "D_phys_t = torch.tensor(D_phys, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)\n",
    "W_obs_u = torch.tensor(W[iu, ju], dtype=torch.float32, device=device)\n",
    "iu_t = torch.tensor(iu, dtype=torch.long, device=device)\n",
    "ju_t = torch.tensor(ju, dtype=torch.long, device=device)\n",
    "eye_mask = 1.0 - torch.eye(N_NATIONS, device=device)\n",
    "\n",
    "# SVD Residual Initialization\n",
    "K_sp0 = np.exp(-D_phys / r0)\n",
    "np.fill_diagonal(K_sp0, 0.0)\n",
    "s_sp0 = K_sp0.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12\n",
    "W_sp0 = 0.5 * c_target * (K_sp0 / s_sp0 + K_sp0 / s_sp0.T)\n",
    "R_init = np.maximum(0.0, W - W_sp0)\n",
    "\n",
    "U, sv, _ = np.linalg.svd(R_init, full_matrices=False)\n",
    "S_init = U[:, :d_s] * np.sqrt(sv[:d_s])\n",
    "S_init = (S_init - S_init.mean(axis=0)) / (S_init.std() + 1e-9) * 3.0\n",
    "\n",
    "logit_lam = torch.tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32, requires_grad=True, device=device)\n",
    "log_r = torch.tensor(log_r0, dtype=torch.float32, requires_grad=True, device=device)\n",
    "S_param = torch.tensor(S_init, dtype=torch.float32, requires_grad=True, device=device)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Step A: Adam Warmup (50 steps)\n",
    "adam_opt = torch.optim.Adam([\n",
    "    {\"params\": [logit_lam], \"lr\": 0.08},\n",
    "    {\"params\": [log_r], \"lr\": 0.05},\n",
    "    {\"params\": [S_param], \"lr\": 0.10}\n",
    "])\n",
    "for _ in range(50):\n",
    "    adam_opt.zero_grad()\n",
    "    lam = torch.sigmoid(logit_lam)\n",
    "    r = torch.exp(torch.clamp(log_r, log_r0 - 3.0, log_r0 + 3.0))\n",
    "    K_sp = torch.exp(-D_phys_t / r) * eye_mask\n",
    "\n",
    "    diff = S_param.unsqueeze(1) - S_param.unsqueeze(0)\n",
    "    dist_sq = (diff ** 2).sum(-1) + 1e-12\n",
    "    D_soc = torch.sqrt(dist_sq) + 1e9 * torch.eye(N_NATIONS, device=device)\n",
    "    K_soc = torch.exp(-D_soc / SIGMA_GAUGE) * eye_mask\n",
    "\n",
    "    W_pred_raw = (1.0 - lam) * K_sp + lam * K_soc\n",
    "    row_sums = W_pred_raw.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True) + 1e-12\n",
    "    W_pred = 0.5 * c_target * (W_pred_raw / row_sums + W_pred_raw / row_sums.t())\n",
    "\n",
    "    w_pred_u = W_pred[iu_t, ju_t]\n",
    "    loss = (w_pred_u - W_obs_u * torch.log(w_pred_u + 1e-12)).sum()\n",
    "    loss = loss + 0.5 * ((log_r - log_r0) / 2.0) ** 2\n",
    "    loss.backward()\n",
    "    adam_opt.step()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Step B: L-BFGS Polish (45 iterations)\n",
    "lbfgs_opt = torch.optim.LBFGS(\n",
    "    [logit_lam, log_r, S_param],\n",
    "    lr=0.5,\n",
    "    max_iter=45,\n",
    "    history_size=10,\n",
    "    line_search_fn=\"strong_wolfe\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "def joint_closure():\n",
    "    lbfgs_opt.zero_grad()\n",
    "    lam = torch.sigmoid(logit_lam)\n",
    "    r = torch.exp(torch.clamp(log_r, log_r0 - 3.0, log_r0 + 3.0))\n",
    "    K_sp = torch.exp(-D_phys_t / r) * eye_mask\n",
    "\n",
    "    diff = S_param.unsqueeze(1) - S_param.unsqueeze(0)\n",
    "    dist_sq = (diff ** 2).sum(-1) + 1e-12\n",
    "    D_soc = torch.sqrt(dist_sq) + 1e9 * torch.eye(N_NATIONS, device=device)\n",
    "    K_soc = torch.exp(-D_soc / SIGMA_GAUGE) * eye_mask\n",
    "\n",
    "    W_pred_raw = (1.0 - lam) * K_sp + lam * K_soc\n",
    "    row_sums = W_pred_raw.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True) + 1e-12\n",
    "    W_pred = 0.5 * c_target * (W_pred_raw / row_sums + W_pred_raw / row_sums.t())\n",
    "\n",
    "    w_pred_u = W_pred[iu_t, ju_t]\n",
    "    loss = (w_pred_u - W_obs_u * torch.log(w_pred_u + 1e-12)).sum()\n",
    "    loss = loss + 0.5 * ((log_r - log_r0) / 2.0) ** 2\n",
    "    loss.backward()\n",
    "    return loss\n",
    "\n",
    "lbfgs_opt.step(joint_closure)\n",
    "\n",
    "lam_hat = float(torch.sigmoid(logit_lam).item())\n",
    "r_hat = float(torch.exp(torch.clamp(log_r, log_r0 - 3.0, log_r0 + 3.0)).item())\n",
    "loss_center = joint_closure().item()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Step C: Fisher Profile Curvature for 95% CI\n",
    "delta_lam = 0.04\n",
    "profile_losses = [loss_center]\n",
    "for offset in [-delta_lam, delta_lam]:\n",
    "    lam_target = np.clip(lam_hat + offset, 0.01, 0.99)\n",
    "    lam_t = torch.tensor(float(lam_target), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)\n",
    "\n",
    "    log_r_prof = log_r.clone().detach().requires_grad_(True)\n",
    "    S_prof = S_param.clone().detach().requires_grad_(True)\n",
    "\n",
    "    prof_opt = torch.optim.LBFGS([log_r_prof, S_prof], lr=0.5, max_iter=25, history_size=10, line_search_fn=\"strong_wolfe\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    def prof_closure():\n",
    "        prof_opt.zero_grad()\n",
    "        r = torch.exp(torch.clamp(log_r_prof, log_r0 - 3.0, log_r0 + 3.0))\n",
    "        K_sp = torch.exp(-D_phys_t / r) * eye_mask\n",
    "\n",
    "        diff = S_prof.unsqueeze(1) - S_prof.unsqueeze(0)\n",
    "        dist_sq = (diff ** 2).sum(-1) + 1e-12\n",
    "        D_soc = torch.sqrt(dist_sq) + 1e9 * torch.eye(N_NATIONS, device=device)\n",
    "        K_soc = torch.exp(-D_soc / SIGMA_GAUGE) * eye_mask\n",
    "\n",
    "        W_pred_raw = (1.0 - lam_t) * K_sp + lam_t * K_soc\n",
    "        row_sums = W_pred_raw.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True) + 1e-12\n",
    "        W_pred = 0.5 * c_target * (W_pred_raw / row_sums + W_pred_raw / row_sums.t())\n",
    "\n",
    "        w_pred_u = W_pred[iu_t, ju_t]\n",
    "        loss = (w_pred_u - W_obs_u * torch.log(w_pred_u + 1e-12)).sum()\n",
    "        loss = loss + 0.5 * ((log_r_prof - log_r0) / 2.0) ** 2\n",
    "        loss.backward()\n",
    "        return loss\n",
    "\n",
    "    prof_opt.step(prof_closure)\n",
    "    profile_losses.append(prof_closure().item())\n",
    "\n",
    "loss_minus = profile_losses[1]\n",
    "loss_plus = profile_losses[2]\n",
    "d2_nll = (loss_plus - 2.0 * loss_center + loss_minus) / (delta_lam ** 2)\n",
    "\n",
    "if d2_nll > 1e-3:\n",
    "    lam_std = float(np.sqrt(1.0 / d2_nll))\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    lam_std = 0.03\n",
    "\n",
    "ci_lo = float(np.clip(lam_hat - 1.96 * lam_std, 0.0, 1.0))\n",
    "ci_hi = float(np.clip(lam_hat + 1.96 * lam_std, 0.0, 1.0))\n",
    "runtime = time.time() - t0\n",
    "\n",
    "S_hat = S_param.detach().cpu().numpy()\n",
    "\n",
    "# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 4. Results Summary Print\n",
    "# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 65)\n",
    "print(f\"WORLD COMMERCIAL NETWORK INFERENCE COMPLETE (Runtime: {runtime:.2f}s)\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 65)\n",
    "print(f\"• Estimated Lambda (Geopolitical / Trade Bloc weight) : {lam_hat:.4f} +/- {lam_std:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"• 95% Confidence Interval                             : [{ci_lo:.4f}, {ci_hi:.4f}]\")\n",
    "print(f\"• Estimated Geographical Trade Distance Scale (r)     : {r_hat:.1f} km\")\n",
    "print(f\"• Geopolitical / Trade Alliance Component (λ)         : {lam_hat * 100:.1f}%\")\n",
    "print(f\"• Geographical Proximity / Gravity Component (1-λ)    : {(1.0 - lam_hat) * 100:.1f}%\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 65)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 5. Diagnostic Visualization\n",
    "# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 11))\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- Panel 1: World Map of Trading Nations ---\n",
    "ax1 = axes[0, 0]\n",
    "scatter1 = ax1.scatter(df_top[\"lon\"], df_top[\"lat\"], c=np.log1p(df_top[\"total_trade\"]), cmap=\"plasma\",\n",
    "                       s=np.log1p(df_top[\"total_trade\"]) * 3.0 + 15, alpha=0.85, edgecolors=\"k\", lw=0.5)\n",
    "ax1.set_xlabel(\"Longitude (deg)\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "ax1.set_ylabel(\"Latitude (deg)\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "ax1.set_title(\"1. Physical Geography of Global Trading Nations\", fontweight=\"bold\", fontsize=11)\n",
    "ax1.grid(True, linestyle=\"--\", alpha=0.4)\n",
    "cb1 = plt.colorbar(scatter1, ax=ax1)\n",
    "cb1.set_label(\"Log Total Trade Volume\", fontsize=9)\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- Panel 2: Inferred Geopolitical / Trade Bloc Latent Space ---\n",
    "ax2 = axes[0, 1]\n",
    "scatter2 = ax2.scatter(S_hat[:, 0], S_hat[:, 1], c=np.log1p(df_top[\"total_trade\"]), cmap=\"plasma\",\n",
    "                       s=np.log1p(df_top[\"total_trade\"]) * 3.0 + 15, alpha=0.85, edgecolors=\"k\", lw=0.5)\n",
    "# Annotate key trading nations\n",
    "for idx in range(min(12, N_NATIONS)):\n",
    "    iso = df_top.loc[idx, \"iso\"]\n",
    "    ax2.annotate(iso, (S_hat[idx, 0], S_hat[idx, 1]),\n",
    "                 textcoords=\"offset points\", xytext=(4, 4), fontsize=9, fontweight=\"bold\", color=\"#0f172a\")\n",
    "ax2.set_xlabel(\"Latent Geopolitical Dimension 1\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "ax2.set_ylabel(\"Latent Geopolitical Dimension 2\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "ax2.set_title(\"2. Inferred Geopolitical Trade Bloc Space (S)\", fontweight=\"bold\", fontsize=11)\n",
    "ax2.grid(True, linestyle=\"--\", alpha=0.4)\n",
    "cb2 = plt.colorbar(scatter2, ax=ax2)\n",
    "cb2.set_label(\"Log Total Trade Volume\", fontsize=9)\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- Panel 3: Bilateral Trade Volume vs Physical Distance ---\n",
    "ax3 = axes[1, 0]\n",
    "weights_u = W[iu, ju]\n",
    "d_phys_u = D_phys[iu, ju]\n",
    "active_pairs = weights_u > 0\n",
    "\n",
    "ax3.scatter(d_phys_u[active_pairs], weights_u[active_pairs], color=\"#6366f1\", alpha=0.35, s=14, label=\"Observed Bilateral Trade\")\n",
    "d_curve = np.linspace(0, 12000, 200)\n",
    "spatial_decay_curve = (1.0 - lam_hat) * np.exp(-d_curve / r_hat) * (c_target / (np.exp(-d_curve/r_hat).mean() + 1e-6))\n",
    "ax3.plot(d_curve, spatial_decay_curve, color=\"red\", lw=2.5, ls=\"--\", label=f\"Fitted Gravity Decay (r = {r_hat:.0f} km)\")\n",
    "ax3.set_xlabel(\"Physical Geographical Distance (km)\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "ax3.set_ylabel(\"Log Bilateral Trade (w_ij)\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "ax3.set_title(\"3. Bilateral Trade vs Geographical Distance (Gravity Model)\", fontweight=\"bold\", fontsize=11)\n",
    "ax3.set_ylim(bottom=0)\n",
    "ax3.grid(True, linestyle=\"--\", alpha=0.4)\n",
    "ax3.legend(loc=\"upper right\", fontsize=9)\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- Panel 4: Inferred Lambda Estimate & 95% Confidence Interval ---\n",
    "ax4 = axes[1, 1]\n",
    "ax4.errorbar([0], [lam_hat], yerr=[[lam_hat - ci_lo], [ci_hi - lam_hat]],\n",
    "             fmt=\"o\", color=\"#d97706\", ecolor=\"#fbbf24\", elinewidth=3,\n",
    "             capsize=8, capthick=2, markersize=10, label=f\"Estimated λ = {lam_hat:.3f}\")\n",
    "ax4.set_xlim(-0.6, 0.6)\n",
    "ax4.set_ylim(0.0, 1.0)\n",
    "ax4.set_xticks([])\n",
    "ax4.set_ylabel(\"Mixing Parameter (λ)\", fontsize=10)\n",
    "ax4.set_title(f\"4. Estimated λ: {lam_hat:.3f} | 95% CI: [{ci_lo:.3f}, {ci_hi:.3f}]\", fontweight=\"bold\", fontsize=11)\n",
    "ax4.axhline(1.0, color=\"gray\", ls=\":\", alpha=0.6, label=\"Pure Trade Bloc (λ=1.0)\")\n",
    "ax4.axhline(0.5, color=\"blue\", ls=\"--\", alpha=0.5, label=\"Balanced Gravity-Trade (λ=0.5)\")\n",
    "ax4.axhline(0.0, color=\"gray\", ls=\"--\", alpha=0.6, label=\"Pure Physical Distance (λ=0.0)\")\n",
